description: React component for editing slash commands in Mattermost integrations, including UI rendering, command validation, and confirmation modal handling.

classes.name: EditCommand
classes.description: React component class for editing a slash command, managing state, user interactions, and rendering the UI.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches team commands on component mount if commands are enabled.

methods.name: editCommand
methods.description: Handles editing of a command, prompts for confirmation if critical fields change.

methods.name: submitCommand
methods.description: Submits the edited command, handles success and error states.

methods.name: renderExtra
methods.description: Renders the confirmation modal with messages and handlers.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the main component UI, including loading state and command editing interface.
